technical_issues.issue: States 'A very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable' – contradicts the design logic; low resolution is undesirable.
Wikipedia (2021 in spaceflight) cited as reference [6], which the task explicitly disallows as a proper source.
Claim that RAAN of 27.33° 'indicates the location of the launch facility' is dubious; RAAN is set by launch time/window, not directly by site.
Assertion that the facility 'will be able to receive all new data from the previous period' is unsupported by any link-budget or data-rate analysis.
Suggests lifespan 'may be lengthened by the addition of solar panels' – solar panels are standard, not an EOL-extension mechanism; also text garbled around drag sail description.

overall: A well-structured, mostly comprehensive mission design with good STK evidence covering all major space-segment requirements. Weakened by a few technical logic errors, unnumbered figures/tables, bare-URL referencing including Wikipedia, and no evidence of attached software files.
